name: Fanar-2-Oryx-IVU
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.292 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-03-17. CAVEATS: the only win is an LLM-judge score (Gemini 2.5 Flash, 1-5) on 3,300 of the vendor's own real user queries; the Arabic multiple-choice table immediately above it is an exact tie with the base on all four benchmarks (48.0/45.0/58.0/74.0 both columns). So the capability claim rests entirely on judge preference, and the gain is +0.27 on a 5-point scale.
